definitions.explanation: An unpleasant sensation of coldness and shivering, typically accompanying fever or the onset of illness. A common medical symptom that signals the body is fighting infection.

examples.japanese: {悪寒|おかん}がして⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦だるい→だるい：05307_darui⟧。
examples.english: I have chills and my body feels sluggish.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昨夜|さくや}→昨夜：02999_sakuya⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{悪寒|おかん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{頭痛|ずつう}→頭痛：03369_zutsuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ことにした。
examples.english: I've had chills and a headache since last night, so I decided to go to the hospital.

notes:
USAGE:
{悪寒|おかん} specifically refers to the chills or shivering that accompany illness, especially fever. It is not used for feeling cold due to weather.

The most common collocation is {悪寒|おかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to have chills/to feel chills).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {悪寒|おかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to feel chills
- {悪寒|おかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧: chills run through one's body
- {悪寒|おかん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{発熱|はつねつ}→発熱：06297_hatsunetsu⟧: chills and fever

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {悪寒|おかん}: chills from illness (medical symptom)
- ⟦{寒気|さむけ}→寒気：16081_samuke⟧: feeling cold, chilliness (broader, can also mean cold air)
- ⟦{震|ふる}え→震え：18840_furue⟧: trembling, shivering (physical action, not limited to illness)
